items.title: Start a homework club
items.description: Pick one evening a week and do homework together in the same room — questions welcome, silence fine.

items.title: Tutor a struggling classmate
items.description: Sit with them for an hour and walk through the topic they dread until it clicks.

items.title: Share your class notes
items.description: Offer your clean notes to someone who missed class or whose notes are a mess.

items.title: Run an exam-season meal train
items.description: Cook or buy an extra portion and drop it at a friend's door during finals week.

items.title: Include the left-out kid
items.description: Invite the quiet one at the edge of the playground or cafeteria into the game or table.

items.title: Walk a new student around
items.description: Show them where everything is, introduce them to your friends, remember their name.

items.title: Carry someone's heavy bag
items.description: Spot the person hauling gear up the stairs and take half the load.

items.title: Lend out your umbrella
items.description: Give it to the person about to walk into the rain; you can duck under a roof.

items.title: Cover a shift for a classmate
items.description: Take their campus café or library shift so they can sit an exam or rest.

items.title: Help a teacher with tech
items.description: Show them how to share their screen or set up the projector before class.

items.title: Teach an elder to video-call
items.description: Help a grandparent or older neighbor learn to video-call their family.

items.title: Read to kids at the library
items.description: Volunteer at the children's story hour and read picture books out loud.

items.title: Swap textbooks with friends
items.description: Trade this term's books so nobody buys new — leave a friendly note inside the cover.

items.title: Leave a kind note in a library book
items.description: Write "good luck, you've got this" on a slip and tuck it into a textbook.

items.title: Compliment someone's work
items.description: Tell a classmate exactly what you admired about their essay or project.

items.title: Defend someone being mocked
items.description: Speak up kindly when a joke goes mean; a single voice changes the room.

items.title: Forgive the fight
items.description: Apologize first or accept the apology; don't let a silly row end a friendship.

items.title: Text a friend who's been absent
items.description: A simple "missed you in class today, everything okay?" goes further than you think.

items.title: Save a seat for the shy one
items.description: Keep the chair next to you open and wave them over.

items.title: Cheer at the school play
items.description: Go to the performance nobody talks about and clap the loudest.

items.title: Draw a portrait of a friend
items.description: Sketch someone in class and give it to them as a surprise.

items.title: Make a playlist for studying
items.description: Build a calm focus playlist and share it with your study group.

items.title: Bake cookies for your dorm floor
items.description: Knock on doors with a warm tray at study time.

items.title: Knit a scarf for winter
items.description: Learn basic knitting and make something warm for someone who shivers.

items.title: Paint a kindness rock
items.description: Decorate a smooth stone with words of encouragement and leave it on campus.

items.title: Sew a patch on a friend's jacket
items.description: Fix the torn sleeve or add a fun patch; small stitches, big gratitude.

items.title: Build a cardboard arcade
items.description: Set up fun cardboard games in the common room for a Friday afternoon.

items.title: Make bookmarks for the library
items.description: Cut and decorate a batch for the librarian to hand out.

items.title: Write a poem for your teacher
items.description: Thank them in verse on the last day of term.

items.title: Photograph the school year
items.description: Collect the candid moments and gift the album to your class at graduation.

items.title: Craft handmade birthday cards
items.description: Keep a stash so nobody's birthday passes unnoticed.

items.title: Design a poster for a good cause
items.description: Make the flyer for the food drive or the charity match.

items.title: Make a welcome kit for exchange students
items.description: A map, a snack, a note in their language — small box, big landing.

items.title: Build a birdhouse for the courtyard
items.description: Simple wood and nails; the birds come, and so do the smiles.

items.title: Write thank-you letters
items.description: Real paper notes to the dinner lady, the cleaner, the coach.

items.title: Organize a campus clean-up
items.description: Grab bags and gloves; pick a Saturday, clean one corner of campus together.

items.title: Join a park clean with classmates
items.description: Meet after class and leave the park better than you found it.

items.title: Work a food bank shift
items.description: Sort donations or hand out parcels for an afternoon; bring a friend.

items.title: Volunteer at the school fair
items.description: Run a stall, carry boxes, sell tickets — show up early.

items.title: Walk shelter dogs together
items.description: Take the whole study group to walk dogs at the local shelter on a weekend.

items.title: Plant trees on campus
items.description: Join the planting morning; your tree will outlive your exams.

items.title: Run a charity fun run
items.description: Train a little, run a lot, wear the silly costume with pride.

items.title: Lead a midnight study walk
items.description: During exam week, take tired friends for a 20-minute walk around campus.

items.title: Organize a textbook swap day
items.description: Book a classroom, lay out the books, let everyone trade for free.

items.title: Start a lunch-time walking club
items.description: Same route, same time daily; conversations happen on their own.

items.title: Plan a group trip to a museum
items.description: Pick the free day, pack snacks, let curiosity lead.

items.title: Cycle to the next town together
items.description: Map a safe route, ride out on a Sunday, celebrate with ice cream.

items.title: Camp out under the stars
items.description: Tents in the backyard or the hills; tell stories, watch the sky.

items.title: Organize a scavenger hunt
items.description: Hide clues across campus; the winning team gets bragging rights.

items.title: Join a beach clean-up
items.description: One tide's worth of plastic, one big group photo at the end.

items.title: Visit a care home with friends
items.description: Go in a group, chat and listen; bring the jam session if they like.

items.title: Volunteer at the children's hospital playroom
items.description: Read, draw, and play in an organized group visit.

items.title: Help at the school garden
items.description: Water, weed, and harvest; take some veg home for dinner.

items.title: Coach kids' Saturday football
items.description: Volunteer with the little league and teach them the basics gently.

items.title: Join a river clean-up day
items.description: Waders on, bags ready; rivers remember who looked after them.

items.title: Quiz a friend before the test
items.description: Fire questions at each other for 20 minutes; the one who asks learns too.

items.title: Explain one concept simply
items.description: Pick the hardest topic and teach it like you're explaining it to a child.

items.title: Start a language practice circle
items.description: Meet weekly, speak only the new language, laugh at mistakes together.

items.title: Be a conversation partner
items.description: Pair up with someone learning your language; talk over coffee once a week.

items.title: Host a puzzle night
items.description: Bring crosswords, riddles, and logic games; teams of mixed ages welcome.

items.title: Teach a friend chess
items.description: Play open games, explain each piece, lose gracefully on purpose sometimes.

items.title: Learn sign language basics together
items.description: Start with the alphabet and greetings; practice at lunch.

items.title: Run a riddle-of-the-week board
items.description: Post one riddle on the classroom door every Monday; reveal Friday.

items.title: Debate the big question
items.description: Pick a fun topic and argue both sides with respect.

items.title: Start a book circle
items.description: Same book, one month, one honest conversation about it.

items.title: Teach a card game to newcomers
items.description: Patient teachers make lifelong players; shuffling is half the fun.

items.title: Host a spelling bee for fun
items.description: Words get silly, trophies get creative, everyone wins something.

items.title: Form an exam study group
items.description: Pick one subject, meet twice a week, take turns teaching the hard bits.

items.title: Solve a mystery together
items.description: Work through a mystery novel or a puzzle game as a team, no skipping ahead.

items.title: Swap skills with a classmate
items.description: You teach them guitar, they teach you coding; one hour each, every week.

items.title: Set up video calls for a grandparent
items.description: Configure the app, save the contacts, do a practice call together.

items.title: Help a classmate fix their laptop
items.description: Troubleshoot the frozen screen or the lost file before they panic.

items.title: Teach someone to spot scams
items.description: Show an older relative how phishing texts work and what to ignore.

items.title: Make a how-to video for teachers
items.description: Record a simple screen tutorial for the school's most-used app.

items.title: Start a study Discord server
items.description: Set up channels per subject; keep it kind, keep it on topic.

items.title: Share class notes online
items.description: Scan your best notes and post them in the group chat before exams.

items.title: Type up notes for a friend
items.description: Transcribe the messy lecture for the classmate who writes slowly.

items.title: Run a digital photo archive
items.description: Collect and label the year's photos so nobody's memories get lost.

items.title: Teach a friend to code
items.description: One small program at a time; celebrate every "it works!"

items.title: Help a small shop go online
items.description: A student weekend project: build a simple page for the corner shop.

items.title: Record an audiobook chapter
items.description: Read a chapter aloud for the school's listening library.

items.title: Make a campus podcast episode
items.description: Interview a teacher or a friend about what they love learning.

items.title: Design a safety poster for the web
items.description: Make a clear, kind graphic about online privacy for younger students.

items.title: Help a friend set strong passwords
items.description: Walk them through a password manager; no judgment, just help.

items.title: Transcribe an interview for the school paper
items.description: Type it up carefully; every voice deserves to be heard right.

items.title: Start a kind comments pact
items.description: Agree with friends to leave three kind comments a day online.

items.title: Work a shift for a cause
items.description: Take one café or market shift and give the wages to the school's charity drive.

items.title: Lift-share to the match
items.description: Offer spare seats in the car to teammates who'd walk otherwise.

items.title: Help the new kid find the bus
items.description: Walk them to the stop on the first day and note the times down.

items.title: Tidy the classroom before you leave
items.description: Stack chairs, pick up paper; the next class walks into calm.

items.title: Water the classroom plants
items.description: Adopt the sad ones by the window; green things remember kindness.

items.title: Organize the lost-property box
items.description: Sort it, label it, and reunite jumpers with their owners.

items.title: Help set up the school dance
items.description: Carry speakers, hang lights, test the playlist; arrive before the crowd.

items.title: Run the tuck-shop rota
items.description: Volunteer a lunch hour to sell snacks and keep the queue friendly.

items.title: Teach a sport to a beginner
items.description: Show someone how to serve, dribble, or swim one calm lesson at a time.

items.title: Start a running group
items.description: Slow pace, no pressure; the slowest runner sets the speed.

items.title: Jam with friends in the park
items.description: Bring instruments, play for anyone who wanders by.

items.title: Perform for a care home
items.description: Take the school band or drama group to play for residents in a group visit.

items.title: Lead the morning warm-up
items.description: Volunteer to run stretches before PE; the grumpy ones will thank you later.

items.title: Help a friend move dorm rooms
items.description: Lend your arms and your Saturday; pizza is traditional payment.

items.title: Draw a map of campus for freshers
items.description: Hand-drawn, with the good shortcuts and the quiet corners marked.
